tez: Costco's fiscal Q3 2026 YTD and TTM filings show broad-based, double-digit-adjacent growth across every deterministic signal (revenue +9.7%, operating income +12.0%, net income +13.5%, operating cash flow +17.6%, free cash flow +16.3%), a Piotroski score of 7/9, and a conservative capital structure (noncurrent financial debt of only 5,670.0 million USD against 18,946.0 million USD of cash). The mechanism is a high-quality, defensively positioned retailer converting consistent top-line growth into expanding cash generation (OCF/net income of 1.79x, operating cash flow margin of 5.37%), which supports paying a premium multiple (P/E 47.76x, earnings yield 2.09%) as long as growth and cash conversion persist; the position is a quality/growth holding rather than a value entry, so the thesis stands on continuation of the growth and liquidity trends rather than on any margin-of-safety in the price.

tez_testleri.failure_condition: ocf_to_net_profit falls below 1.0, indicating earnings are no longer fully cash-backed

belirleyici_veriler.aciklama: Price/Earnings of 47.76x on TTM parent net income reflects a substantial growth/quality premium priced into the shares.
Peer median earnings yield of 4.61% versus COST's 2.09% shows the subject trades materially richer than its retail peer set on this metric.
Operating cash flow grew 17.6% year over year, the strongest of the five deterministic growth signals, supporting the cash-conversion leg of the thesis.
Cash and cash equivalents of 18,946.0 million USD comfortably exceed total reported financial debt, underscoring balance-sheet resilience despite a tight current ratio.
Piotroski F-Score: 7/9, with the only failing components being 'No increase in shares outstanding' and 'Improving asset turnover'.

tezi_bozacak_kosullar: Revenue or operating income growth decelerates toward or below the mid-single digits, removing the justification for the current premium multiple.
Operating cash flow conversion weakens (ocf_to_net_profit drifts toward or below 1.0), signaling earnings quality deterioration.
Continued or accelerating share issuance erodes per-share value, compounding the existing Piotroski flag on shares outstanding.

Liquidity tightens further (current ratio or cash coverage of current liabilities declines) without an offsetting improvement in the refinancing-pressure diagnostic, which is currently rated insufficient data.
A sustained de-rating of the earnings yield relative to peers without a corresponding growth premium would indicate the market has stopped rewarding the quality thesis.
belirsizlik: Current financial debt and current lease liabilities are both marked not available, limiting a precise near-term liquidity/refinancing assessment beyond the mechanical current ratio.
Cash paid for share repurchases during FY2025 is not available, so the capital-return picture (dividends only, at -2,183.0 million USD) is incomplete.
Issuer-reported EBITDA and net-debt APM are both not disclosed, and the refinancing-pressure diagnostic is explicitly flagged as insufficient data.
The debt/lease maturity schedule is sourced from the FY2025 annual note (stale relative to the May 10, 2026 balance sheet) and must not be treated as current.
